verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents its own event-driven automatic actions in two places: failure alerts sent by email, Slack or webhook when tasks fail, and tasks that run when triggered from code. Cron schedules are time-based recurrence rather than event rules, so they do not count toward this story, and there is no general rules engine for mapping events to actions. Missing for 10: a declarative event-to-action rule configuration, documented event sources beyond task failure and programmatic triggers, and independent corroboration of event-rule automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
